game.title: Lords of the Fallen
game.blurb: Action RPG in which Harkyn battles a series of bosses, from Deck 13 and CI Games, released 2014-10-28. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Harkyn's journey and its choices. Spoiler-guarded; most achievements here are hidden on Steam.

chapters.title: Bosses
chapters.summary: The Warden, the Worshiper, the Beast, the Lost Brothers and the other bosses, plus boss feats.

chapters.title: Exploration and Collections
chapters.summary: Audio notes, Treasure Chambers, Proving Grounds, Infinite Voids, special weapons and every enemy type.

chapters.title: Class Playthroughs
chapters.summary: Finishing the game as a Cleric, a Rogue and a Warrior.

chapters.title: The Ancient Labyrinth
chapters.summary: The Ancient Labyrinth, its audio notes and the Keeper. Spoiler-guarded where hidden.

chapters.title: Combat and Growth
chapters.summary: Spells, attribute points, potions, getting your experience back and fighting tricks.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 265300)
StrategyWiki: no page for this game, nothing used
Fandom (lordsofthefallen.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://lordsofthefallen.fandom.com/wiki/Lords_of_the_Fallen_(2014)
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). RAWG's first search result was the 2023 game ("lords-of-the-fallen-2", id 840776), so the detail was replaced with the expected 2014 entry, "lords-of-the-fallen" (id 2047, "Lords of the Fallen (2014)", released 2014-10-28). Steam app 265300 is "Lords Of The Fallen™ 2014" (the 2023 game is app 1501750). No StrategyWiki page under "Lords of the Fallen (2014)" or "Lords of the Fallen". lordsofthefallen.fandom.com answers the API under "Lords of the Fallen (2014)", but the page links to only 2 articles ("Harkyn", "The Lords of the Fallen"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. 24 of 56 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions. Achievements 47 to 56 form a block that starts with "Found all eight audio notes in the Ancient Labyrinth" and includes "Defeated the Keeper"; RAWG also lists "Lords of the Fallen: Ancient Labyrinth" (2015) as a separate entry, so the 8 hidden achievements in that block were placed in the Ancient Labyrinth chapter by name. That is a judgement call. The other 16 hidden ones (for example "Harkyn collection" and "God is dead") sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder. RAWG lists a playtime of only 4 hours, which looks low.
